notes: Hostable enforcement point: pi's tool_call permission chain (T4) and the in-process policy engine at the tool-call hook (T6; harnesses/pi/config/t6-policy.json). Replay injection runs inside the pi agent process via the extension-command surface; no LLM. Id-echo claims are false in v1: the adapter does not set correlation carriers yet (C5, M2). t7 (0.2.0): the kernel-position design; the harness itself runs in its t0 configuration (no intrinsic enforcement) — the selected kernel control (e.g. actplane) enforces from the host.
